name: FullStory
label: Fullstory Server API V2 — users (session replay default-deny)
description: Official Fullstory Server API V2 at https://api.fullstory.com/v2. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: Authorization: Basic {apiKey}. Session replay URLs and event streams are highly sensitive (DPA). segment.list is omitted (V1-only). Select session.search / event.search only when the customer DPA allows. Customer owns the Fullstory org. apiKey is never logged or returned. Never log session URLs, emails, uid, or event bodies.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put apiKey here. Minimize: send only the id/email/uid needed. Example: {"operation":"user.get","id":"…"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'user.get' | 'user.search' | 'session.search' | 'event.search'. segment.list is not offered.

schema.label: sessionId
schema.description: Provider session id for event.search (userId:sessionId form; path-encoded).

schema.label: email
schema.description: user.search / session.search email filter. Official email.

schema.label: uid
schema.description: Customer user id for user.search / session.search.

schema.label: session_uid
schema.description: Mutually exclusive with uid/email on session.search.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size. session.search default 20; single page only.

schema.label: paginationToken
schema.description: Next page token for user.search when the 200 body includes one.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Do not persist replay URLs. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Highly sensitive for session.search / event.search — do not log.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: user.get | user.search | session.search | event.search. session.search / event.search return replay URLs / event JSON — operator DPA must allow.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Fullstory Server API key (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Basic {apiKey} per V2 Users. Never log or place on INPUT. Admin/Architect required for many reads.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Use 60 for event.search. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
